en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father, my brother, and ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain all narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥusain ibn Sa’īd, (from Muḥammad ibn Sinān), from ‘Abdil Malik Al-Qummi, from Ismā’īl ibn Jābir, from ‘Abdil Ḥamīd – the servant of Ismā’īl ibn Ja’far, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
You can establish (the obligatory) prayers in full form in four locations: in Masjid Al-Ḥarām, in the Mosque of the Messenger (s.a.a.w.), in the Mosque of Kūfah, and in the Ḥaram of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
